title: Her Job Was to Translate Every Word Exactly. Even the Cruel Ones. #Shorts
description:
The chair is always slightly behind and to the left. You do not lean forward. You do not react to anything that is said — not to a joke, not to bad news, not to a lie.

Giulia Sarti did that job for twenty-nine years, in about two hundred rooms, for the same actress. Then, in 1981, she broke the rule once.
